channel.name: legs
channel.purpose: Leg and ankle: design, drop test, gait gantry

quirks: ALL CAPS for part numbers and deadlines

context: Channel for Leg (left, hip to foot).
Ongoing: Gait policy trained in sim overshoots on hardware; friction and backlash modelling. This week: Ravi: RL gait policy walks in sim, chatters on hardware.
Ongoing: FOC rewrite with a thermal model and derating for DVT actuators. This week: v2 build slips a week; dyno sweep waits on it.
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles. This week: Rev C release moves the cable inboard; Farah asks for high-flex cable on the next harness.
Ongoing: Integrated DVT plan across actuators and legs and which dates are real. This week: Omar flags the DVT motor as the long pole; Arjun says it is fine.
Ongoing: Spend running ahead of plan; push to stop default expedites. This week: Samir reports expedite share down from 34% to 22%; two builds slipped anyway.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting. This week: First static load to 2x: 0.6 mm deflection at the hip mount, within spec.
